tests.details: GameplayHUD component active on Canvas and linked to MoveManager, EnergyManager, and SaveManager.

tests.name: Pause, Resume & Home Navigation
tests.details: PauseButton pauses timeScale to 0; ResumeButton restores timescale and closes popup; MenuButton navigates home.

tests.details: CharacterMover safely travels path from source to sink; rescued character is fixed to Clownfish without companion mutation.

tests.details: Win condition triggers LevelCompletePanel with sequential star reveal; fail triggers LevelFailedPanel; rewards awarded accurately.
